snippet.title: Re:cord NOAH Fractal of OblivionNintendo Switch™ First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
Brand new from AmuLit! A first look at Re:cord NOAH Fractal of Oblivion! 

This upcoming otome title, developed in collaboration with the Soyogi Fractal project from famed voice actor Yuki Kaji, is set in a completely original world crafted just for this game.

"You taught me emotions I never knew existed."

◆X (Twitter)◆
Re:cord NOAH Fractal of Oblivion: https://x.com/RecordNOAH
AmuLit: https://x.com/AmuLit_Global

◆Official Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/

◆Official Portal Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/switch/

◆Cast◆
Kazuki Ura / Hiro Shimono / Katsuyuki Konishi / Takuya Sato / Yuki Kaji

◆Featured Creators◆
Director: Tsugume (Voltage Inc.)
Narrative Writers: Tom, Alice Kanae
Illustrator: Domino Ozaki
Background Art: YUKIMON
Soundtrack: Yuki Hayashi
Theme Song: suisoh
Soyogi Fractal Executive Producer: Yuki Kaji 

◆Soyogi Fractal Official Site◆
https://soyogi-fractal.com/
――――――――――――――

*AmuLit is Voltage's brand for console games.
